# Re: Automated Code Review — ✅ APPROVE

Thank you — agreeing this PR is complete as authored. No code change is required for this thread; this reply is an audit confirmation on head `d5d73cecc89b491f74daae38bb48163e2c751ab7` (no new commits pushed).

Re-verified every claim locally against the head tree:

- `python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py --check` → `Quarantine list OK: 12 entr(ies), all documented`, exit 0.
- The new entry's shape matches `flake_watch.py::quarantine_entry` field-for-field (`file`, `test`, `issue`, `since`, `runs`) and is append-only — the other 11 entries are untouched by commit `8123a371d5`.
- The recorded `test` name matches the Dart test's runtime name verbatim: the source splits it across two adjacent string literals (`test/integration/job_card_heredoc_pty_test.dart:118-119`), which Dart concatenates at compile time into exactly `60-line heredoc job: bounded card, body never rendered, viewport pages over the block with the composer reserved`.
- Gate-filter smoke check: `echo "test/integration/job_card_heredoc_pty_test.dart" | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py` drops the file with `::warning::quarantined (gh-1199 AC6) … https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/2024` and passes other targets through — so both gate legs (pty-integration shards, integration-mock) skip it while nightly keeps it for the AC4 repeat-run proof, exactly as summarized.

On the validation red that re-queued this rework: both failing checks trace to one infra root cause, not to this diff (`scripts/test_quarantine.json`, data-only).

- `Cube kernel live (macOS)` died on the self-hosted runner `fa-m5-1` downloading the pinned `actions/cache` tarball from `codeload.github.com` (100 s `HttpClient.Timeout`, 3 attempts) — before any checkout/test work ran.
- `Quality gate` then failed only because that platform leg was red — the aggregate cascade the verdict step documents itself (`dart_ok` stays `true`, publish not gated on platform legs, #1368).
- `ci_violations.json` ownership census: `owned: 0` — nothing attributable to this PR's files.

Validation re-dispatches on the current head (red 1/3, no new head required); the merge-as-is recommendation stands pending that green re-run.
